name: Sweden
title: The Kingdom of Sweden
pressure_shape: Stronger Invaders: extra Blight on 4+ overkill (L1), extra City at Setup (L2), Town 3 / City 5 Damage (L3), Accelerated deck (L4), Towns after Ravage Blight (L5); Escalation replaces Dahan with Towns; no additional loss condition.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Swayed by the Invaders
stage_ii_escalation.text: After Invaders Explore into each land, if that land has at least as many Invaders as Dahan, replace 1 Dahan with 1 Town.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheKingdomOfSweden), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.3 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Swayed by the Invaders): After Invaders Explore into each land, if that land has at least as many Invaders as Dahan, replace 1 Dahan with 1 Town. Additional loss condition: none.
levels.notes: R-ADV-SWE-L0a, R-ADV-SWE-L0b. Escalation happens after Exploring.

levels.name: Heavy Mining
levels.escalation: When a Ravage does 4+ overkill to the land, add an extra Blight. (This does not cause extra cascades / Presence destruction.)
levels.notes: R-ADV-SWE-L1. Nature Incarnate wording (NI p.14), as the engine (Brett, Q18). Older Wiki text: 'If the Invaders do at least 6 Damage to the land during Ravage'; same at land Health 2.

levels.name: Population Pressure at Home
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board add 1 City to land #4. On boards where land #4 starts with Blight, put that Blight in land #5 instead.

levels.name: Fine Steel for Tools and Guns
levels.escalation: Town deal 3 Damage. City deal 5 Damage.

levels.name: Royal Backing
levels.escalation: At the end of Setup, Accelerate the Invader Deck. (After the initial Explore, discard the topmost card of the lowest Invader Stage in the deck.) On each board, add 1 Town to the land matching the discarded card with the fewest Invaders.
levels.notes: R-ADV-SWE-L4a, R-ADV-SWE-L4b. Engine timing confirmed by the FAQ (NQ-A): the Accelerate happens after the initial Explore. The discarded card goes face-up to the Invader discard and is public (NQ-E).

levels.name: Mining Rush
levels.escalation: When Ravaging adds at least 1 Blight to a land, also add 1 Town to an adjacent land without Town/City. Cascading Blight does not cause this effect.

levels.name: Prospecting Outpost
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board add 1 Town and 1 Blight to land #8. The Blight comes from the box, not the Blight Card.
